purpose: Decision-specific Graphify and CodeGraph evidence contract

admission.READY: Both graph tools are command-ok, relevant, complete and not truncated, and mandatory source readback is resolved.
admission.SOURCE_FALLBACK: Source readback is resolved but one or more graph observations are generic, non-relevant, failed, or incomplete.
admission.HOLD_THIS_SEAM: Mandatory source readback is unresolved; no graph result may authorize the seam.

fail_closed_rules: A non-empty result is not automatically relevant.
A truncated result is never complete coverage.
A generic CodeGraph helper hit is NO_RELEVANCE unless exact seeds and expected edges resolve.
Graph evidence navigates and discovers scope; source, contract, and tests determine the engineering conclusion.
Every receipt is bound to the exact target_sha and records the source fallback decision independently.
